name: Droptop Four
description: Reference-based Ubuntu GNOME adaptation with live native widgets.

reference.creator: Cariboudjan / Droptop Four contributors
reference.fidelity: Independent reference-based adaptation; not a pixel-identical or complete Windows suite port.
notes: Includes the top menu bar, installed-apps dropdown, Files/Settings/Search actions, status readings and clock.
The bar appears below GNOME’s existing top panel. Windows directory catalogs, proprietary community apps and paid Supporter features are not ported.
